# Matzus Law, LLC

> > Pittsburgh-based medical malpractice and birth injury law firm with experienced trial lawyers and medical experts fighting for victims of healthcare negligence.

Matzus Law, LLC is a specialized medical malpractice and personal injury law firm serving Western Pennsylvania. The firm combines legal expertise with in-house medical professionals including board-certified physicians and physician assistants to build strong cases for victims of medical negligence and birth injuries.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice
- Birth Injury
- Cerebral Palsy
- Erb's Palsy
- Birth Asphyxia
- Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE)
- Medical Negligence
- Trial Lawyers
- Pittsburgh, PA
- Personal Injury Law
- Wrongful Death
- Fetal Distress
- Birth Defects
- Legal Representation
- Medical-Legal Consulting
